sourceScope: Original index.html section#v11 with both text blocks and Replay; original shared setUpBlock/setUpVariation logic. Not all 19 variations, Hero, pager or full-page Smoother.
changes: Import original GSAP3.15 runtime plugins as local modules; no Flip or ScrollSmoother emitted. Original upstream vendored plugin headers also state3.15.0.

Preserve original per-letter timing/jitter/word assignment/coordinates/fresh-color/caret blink algorithm. Capture SplitText instances and revert on disposal; null canvas2D explicitly fails rather than synthetic font metrics.
Preserve shared scroll enter/rearm/block click/replay semantics, scope to one original chapter and retain hidden readable paragraphs.
Remove font-face and font preload; original font fallback uses local system font, glyph metrics and appearance differ. No font binary shipped.
Remove decorative full-page grain PNG overlay, without counterfeit texture; original background color/layout/caret CSS retained.
No realtime collaboration, microphone, model or networking. At most3local script carets per block; one-line ONE WORD uses2active writers, original third unused caret stays hidden.
Hidden cancel pending fonts promise via generation, kill timeline/trigger/splits and remount on visible; reduced uses original show and disables GSAP ticker/ScrollTrigger.
